blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
In the UK, time is taken seriously. If a meeting is at 10, people log in at 9:55. Arriving ten minutes late without a message is noticed — even if nobody says anything.

The rules are simple. Be on time, or a couple of minutes early. If you are going to be late, send a quick message. Finish meetings on time. When you promise something by Friday, you mean Friday.

Respect for time is, quietly, one of the main ways the British judge how professional you are.

items.q: If a meeting is at 10, when do people usually log in?
items.why: "If a meeting is at 10, people log in at 9:55." — alguns minutos antes.

items.q: What should you do if you are going to be late?
items.why: "If you are going to be late, send a quick message."

items.q: What does "by Friday" mean in the text?
items.why: "When you promise something by Friday, you mean Friday." — a data é firme.

items.q: The text says lateness is "noticed — even if nobody says anything." This suggests that…
options: Nobody cares about time in the UK
People can see your lateness but stay quiet about it
The British always talk about being late
Being late is never a problem
items.why: Inferência: o silêncio não quer dizer que ninguém reparou.

items.q: The author would most likely DISAGREE with which idea?
options: A short message helps if you are late
Time is taken seriously in the UK
Being ten minutes late is fine if you stay quiet
items.why: Inferência: o texto todo diz que o atraso é notado, mesmo sem comentário.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Harry falando com um colega novo. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi, welcome to the team. Let me give you one small tip about British meetings.

If a meeting starts at ten, please log in at five to ten. Not exactly at ten, and never after. A couple of minutes early looks professional here.

Last week a new colleague joined a call five minutes late. He said nothing. People smiled and carried on, but I could see them look at the clock. Nobody spoke about it. Still, everybody noticed.

So here is the simple rule. If you know you will be late, send a short message. Just say, "Running five minutes late, sorry." That is all. It takes ten seconds, and it changes everything.

And when you promise something by Friday, please finish it by Friday. Not Monday, not "soon". Here, a deadline is a deadline.

Being on time is quiet, but it builds your reputation fast. Trust me, it matters more than any report.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: If a meeting starts at ten, when does Harry want the new colleague to log in?
items.why: "please log in at five to ten… A couple of minutes early looks professional."

items.q: What happened when a new colleague joined a call five minutes late?
items.why: "Nobody spoke about it. Still, everybody noticed."

items.q: What message does Harry suggest if you will be late?
items.why: "Just say, 'Running five minutes late, sorry.'"

items.q: When Harry says a deadline "is a deadline," he means…
options: The date can move to Monday
You should finish on the exact day you promised
items.why: Inferência: "by Friday" quer dizer sexta, não segunda nem 'em breve'.

items.q: How would you best describe Harry's tone?
options: Friendly but clear about the rules
items.why: Inferência: ele dá boas-vindas e ajuda, mas deixa a regra bem clara.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "She is always punctual; she never keeps people waiting." Punctual means…
items.why: Punctual = pontual, chega na hora certa.

items.q: "The report has a deadline on Friday." A deadline is…
options: a final date to finish something
items.why: Deadline = prazo, a data-limite para entregar.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Please send a short ___ if you cannot come."
items.why: Warning = aviso; você avisa antes que não pode vir.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Let me check my ___ to find a free time."
items.why: Schedule = agenda, onde estão seus horários.

items.q: "The British value professionalism at work." Professionalism means…
options: acting in a serious, correct way at work
items.why: Professionalism = profissionalismo, agir de forma séria e correta.

blocks.instruction: Expressões e verbos comuns em reuniões. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "The meeting starts at ten, so please be on time." To be on time means to…
items.why: Be on time = estar no horário.

items.q: "I am running late, sorry." This means you are…
items.why: Running late = atrasado, chegando depois da hora.

items.q: "Can you send this by Friday?" This means finish it…
items.why: By Friday = até sexta, não depois.

items.q: "Let's wrap up the meeting; it is ten o'clock." To wrap up means to…
items.why: Wrap up = encerrar, terminar a reunião.

items.q: "Please let me know if you will be late." This means…
items.why: Let me know = me avise, me conte.
